name: Younger
description: Liza Miller, a suddenly single stay-at-home mother, tries to get back into the working world, only to find it’s nearly impossible to start at the bottom at 40-year old. When a chance encounter convinces her she looks younger than she is, Liza tries to pass herself off as 26 and lands a job as an assistant at Empirical Press. Now she just has to make sure no one finds out the secret only she and her best friend Maggie share.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: 40-year-old Liza passes herself off as 26 to land a job in the field of her dreams. Now she just has to make sure no one discovers her secret.

videos.title: Liza Sows Her Oates
videos.overview: While settling into life as a 26-year-old, Liza looks to date someone age-appropriate, and learn to market to a younger audience.

videos.title: IRL
videos.overview: Liza struggles with the anxiety of sex with Josh and gets a little help from Maggie. At work, Kelsey pulls out all the stops to land a hot new author, while Diana dips her toe into the online dating pool.

videos.title: The Exes
videos.overview: Liza tries to keep her distance from Josh, but reconsiders when she has a surprise run-in; Kelsey asks Liza to keep her in check.

videos.title: Girl Code
videos.overview: After helping Kelsey, Liza joins Kelsey's inner circle, neglecting Maggie at a bad time; Diana is excited by the arrival of a publisher.

videos.title: Shedonism
videos.overview: Diana tasks Liza with running a book launch party for a demanding author; Maggie encounters an old crush; Kelsey starts to fall for her new author.

videos.title: Broke and Panty-less
videos.overview: When her ex shorts her on her daughter's tuition payment, Liza needs to earn cash quickly without arousing suspicion; Kelsey continues to blur the lines.

videos.title: Sk8
videos.overview: As the grind of 20-something life continues to wear Liza down, she glimpses a more age-appropriate world when her publisher needs her to babysit. Kelsey's affair with her author finally comes to a head at an award ceremony.

videos.title: I'm With Stupid
videos.overview: Liza returns to her New Jersey book club in hopes of creating interest in an unpublished author; Josh gives Liza the cold shoulder.

videos.title: The Boy With the Dragon Tattoo
videos.overview: After a bedbug scare forces Liza into some uncomfortable and illuminating sleeping arrangements, she struggles to close the deal on her first literary find.

videos.title: Hot Mitzvah
videos.overview: Liza learns of a new career option; Lauren throws a bat mitzvah; Kelsey deals with the aftermath of her affair.

videos.title: The Old Ma'am and the C
videos.overview: Liza's lies come to a disastrous head on multiple fronts, threatening to ruin her professionally and romantically.

videos.title: Tattoo You
videos.overview: Liza tries to sort out her relationship with Josh as her daughter Caitlin returns from school.

videos.title: The Mao Function
videos.overview: Liza questions Josh's interest in her while another publisher courts Kelsey.

videos.title: Like a Boss
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey prepare to launch their new imprint in spite of online criticism.

videos.title: The Jade Crusade
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey pursue their first author, but her interest in them isn't purely professional.

videos.title: Jersey, Sure
videos.overview: Hoping to learn more about Liza’s life, Josh attends a dinner in Jersey with her, and receives a hard dose of reality.

videos.title: Un-Jaded
videos.overview: When their first author proves to be more trouble than she’s worth, Liza and Kelsey worry their imprint might be over before it ever gets started

videos.title: Into the Woods & Out of the Woods
videos.overview: Liza goes to a music festival with Josh and helps Charles with a work assignment.

videos.title: Beyond Therapy
videos.overview: Josh and Liza's relationship becomes strained after he is included in a New York Times profile.

videos.title: The Good Shepherd
videos.overview: Liza pursues an author she likes because of his minimalist manifesto.

videos.title: Bad Romance
videos.overview: Liza joins an assistants' networking group where she learns more than she wants to about Thad.

videos.title: Secrets & Liza
videos.overview: Empirical welcomes its biggest author and Liza tries to convince Thad to tell Kelsey the truth.

videos.title: No Weddings & a Funeral
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes and Liza wonders if she should end her 26-year-old life forever.

videos.title: A Kiss is Just a Kiss
videos.overview: Liza sends Caitlin off to college and struggles to weigh her feelings for both Josh and Charles.

videos.title: The Marshmallow Experiment
videos.overview: Liza’s identity is under threat by Thad’s laptop and Kelsey being exposed to the truth. A Silicon Valley billionaire invests in Empirical.

videos.title: Last Days of Books
videos.overview: Liza rallies the Empirical team to save her hometown bookstore from closure. Kelsey dips her toe back into the dating world.

videos.title: A Night at the Opera
videos.overview: Liza has to bridge millennial divides in the workplace and in her personal life when Empirical’s new investor tasks her with signing YouTube stars.

videos.title: P is for Pancake
videos.overview: Kelsey dates a seemingly perfect guy, but Liza and Lauren think it’s too soon. At a party of doctors, Josh puts his relationship with Liza under the microscope.

videos.title: Me, Myself, and O
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey pursue an erotica author writing under a pseudonym, and are shocked to discover their identity.

videos.title: Ladies Who Lust
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey try to preserve their author’s anonymity, but a women’s erotica event threatens to expose the truth.

videos.title: What's Up, Dock?
videos.overview: Liza finally makes her divorce official. Diana meets a hot stranger outside of work. Liza ends up in the hospital.

videos.title: Summer Friday
videos.overview: After Liza and Kelsey strike a deal for Colin's novel, an unexpected publicity hype leads to a bidding war. Emboldened by her therapist, Diana introduces herself to Richard, the therapist who works next door.

videos.title: Pigeons, Parrots, and Storks
videos.overview: Liza and Josh's future together is thrown into question after having opposing reactions to a near miss.

videos.title: A Book Fair to Remember
videos.overview: While facing an impasse with Josh, Liza draws closer to Charles at the Hamptons Book Fair. Kelsey feels erased from Colin's narrative.

videos.title: Get Real
videos.overview: Liza returns from the Hamptons and has to deal with the aftermath. A famous life coach, whose book Empirical is pursuing, forces Liza to face some hard truths.

videos.title: Post Truth
videos.overview: Liza deals with the aftermath of coming clean with Kelsey, and Charles tests their synchronicity. Kelsey and Josh become unlikely allies.

videos.title: Gettin' Hygge with It
videos.overview: Liza faces further fallout with Kelsey, who is infuriated by Liza's lack of millennial know-how.

videos.title: Forged in Fire
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey reach breaking point at a work retreat. Liza receives news that changes everything.

videos.title: In the Pink
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey dive back into the dating pool and quickly discover it's much more complicated than they'd hoped.

videos.title: The Gift of the Maggie
videos.overview: Liza hunts for a new romance author, bringing her closer to Charles. Maggie slashes an art competitor.

videos.title: A Close Shave
videos.overview: The success of Liza and Kelsey's latest title spurs a Twitter feud, ending in disaster. Maggie meets a woman with a little something extra.

videos.title: Fever Pitch
videos.overview: Liza discovers an exciting new author, whose pitch takes an unexpected turn. Kelsey avoids the wrath of Charles, and escapes upstate with Josh and Lauren.

videos.title: The Gelato and the Pube
videos.overview: Liza receives a great opportunity at work, but there's a catch. Josh meets someone new. Maggie rustles some feathers.

videos.title: The Incident at Pound Ridge
videos.overview: Sparks fly at the annual Empirical Publishing picnic. Liza finds herself caught between Josh and Charles.

videos.title: A Novel Marriage
videos.overview: Liza is drawn into her author's Upper East Side life, forcing her worlds to collide. Kelsey comes to Lauren's rescue.

videos.title: It's Love, Actually
videos.overview: Liza pursues a new relationship as Kelsey revisits an old one. Diana learns the truth about Richard. Lauren encourages Josh to follow his heart.

videos.title: Irish Goodbye
videos.overview: Liza and Maggie meet Josh in Ireland. Kelsey is forced to play nice with a new colleague. Charles's personal life is thrown into the spotlight.

videos.title: #LizaToo
videos.overview: Liza returns to Empirical hoping to resume business as usual, but Charles announces a new project that spurs several unsettling revelations.

videos.title: A Titanic Problem
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey seek out a potential business partner for Millennial, and newlywed Josh returns to Brooklyn and Charles sees Liza with fresh eyes.

videos.title: The End of the Tour
videos.overview: Liza faces complications on the "Marriage Vacation" book tour. Kelsey and Zane head to Washington, D.C., to court a speechwriter's prospective memoir.

videos.title: The Talented Mr. Ridley
videos.overview: Liza gets to know a charming journalist and confronts Charles, Diana agrees to a date with a familiar face, and Josh wants a reset.

videos.title: Big Little Liza
videos.overview: Liza worries about her daughter's online activities, Kelsey's relationship with Jake crosses a professional boundary, and Josh contemplates a long-term decision.

videos.title: Sex, Liza and Rock & Roll
videos.overview: Kelsey is torn between Jake and Zane, Liza helps Charles retrieve an eccentric rock star's manuscript, and Diana ventures to Staten Island.

videos.title: A Christmas Miracle
videos.overview: It's Christmas in New York! Liza must attend a party with Caitlin and her ex-husband, Kelsey finds herself caught up in a web of her own making as she struggles to keep both her relationships under wraps, and Charles glimpses Liza’s other life.

videos.title: The Bubble
videos.overview: After the holidays, Liza adjusts to a new normal as she and Charles take their relationship to the next level. Maggie hears some hard truths from an ex, and Kelsey course-corrects her love life.

videos.title: Honk if You're Horny
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey find themselves at odds over two book offers when a self-made billionaire pitches a book on power to Millennial. Kelsey is honored with an award, and Lauren works her magic as a publicist.

videos.title: Girls on the Side
videos.overview: Josh celebrates at his launch party, Liza is tired of keeping secrets, Caitlin's new middle-aged boyfriend raises eyebrows, and Diana meets a challenge head-on.

videos.title: Fraudlein
videos.overview: In a last-ditch effort to save the company, Charles takes Empirical and Millennial to the world's biggest annual book fair in Frankfurt, Germany where Liza receives an offer that could uncomplicate her life.

videos.title: Lizability
videos.overview: Change is in the air at Empirical, and Liza considers her options. Meanwhile, Kelsey receives surprising news, and Charles finds a solution.

videos.title: Big Day
videos.overview: Kelsey makes her debut as publisher, quickly realizing that the company is in trouble. The new regime – and a revelation about Liza – sends Diana into crisis. Josh finds out the paternity of Clare’s baby.

videos.title: Flush with Love
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey clash with Quinn, who’s walking the line between author and investor. Diana offends Enzo. Lauren throws a gender reveal party for Clare's baby.

videos.title: The Unusual Suspect
videos.overview: Liza and Charles' romance heats up, but Liza suspects he's keeping something from her. Millennial gets the scoop on a tell-all from acquitted murderer Audrey Colbert. Kelsey feels undermined by Quinn.

videos.title: An Inside Glob
videos.overview: Liza worries about Charles's possible business venture, the stress of being publisher takes a toll on Kelsey, and Millennial has a new competitor.

videos.title: Stiff Competition
videos.overview: Liza and Charles use competiton to spice up their relationship. Kelsey and Diana question Liza’s loyalty. Josh reaps the perks of going viral.

videos.title: Merger, She Wrote
videos.overview: Liza and Charles attend a micro-dosing retreat, where Liza is surprised by new friends and familiar faces. Brownyn Madigan finds an unlikely voice for her audio books. Maggie gets hogtied.

videos.title: Friends with Benefits
videos.overview: Kelsey struggles to integrate Mercury into Millennial, Liza finds a compelling manuscript in Charles's moving boxes, and Enzo and Diana's relationship reaches a new level.

videos.title: The Debu-taunt
videos.overview: Charles wants to take the next step with Liza. Millennial participates in a Debutante Ball for first-time authors.

videos.title: Millennial's Next Top Model
videos.overview: Millennial's deal with a youth clothing company falls into jeopardy after Liza's age is revealed, Maggie gets a crush on a male artist, and Quinn stages a publicity stunt.

videos.title: It's All About the Money, Honey
videos.overview: Liza's ad campaign features a surprise, Charles and Kelsey take part in an important meeting, and Josh thinks about his future when Clare receives a lucrative offer.

videos.title: Holding Out for a SHero
videos.overview: Liza struggles with the consequences of cutting off Josh, Kelsey has a surprising reaction to her new role at Millennial, and Diana gets a pre-wedding surprise.

videos.title: Forever
videos.overview: Liza struggles to balance without Kelsey. Kelsey strategizes with an unlikely ally. Diana and Charles both make moves for the future.

videos.title: A Decent Proposal
videos.overview: As Diana sets out on her honeymoon, Liza considers Charles's proposal. Kelsey turns Quinn down, but some speed bumps in her personal and professional life make Kelsey doubt herself. Lauren's 30th is out of this world.

videos.title: It's the End of the World, Worm Girl
videos.overview: Liza tries to settle into the next chapter of her personal life. Liza and Kelsey dig deep to win over Fupa Grünhoff, a teenage climate change activist.

videos.title: FKA Millennial
videos.overview: With her personal life on rocky ground, Liza focuses on work and a new book pitch by sexy surfer, Kai Manning. The Empirical team meets with Quinn Tyler, whose latest book idea was inspired by Charles. Empirical rebrands.

videos.title: Risky Business
videos.overview: Liza travels to Montauk to help a sexy pro surfer with his memoir. She comes back to the office refreshed. An unexpected adventure with Quinn leaves Kelsey questioning her career choices. Josh's new love interest gets loud.

videos.title: The Last Unicorn
videos.overview: After Quinn's new romance goes public, Liza decides to fact-check her manuscript. Maggie gets an exciting new job offer and love interest. Sparks fly between Liza and someone from her old life.

videos.title: The F Word
videos.overview: Liza and Kelsey start an underground event called Inkubator. Liza debates telling Charles about Quinn's true motives. Maggie’s first class lands her an invite to dinner at the dean’s.

videos.title: The Son Also Rises
videos.overview: After an Empirical author dies, Charles reconnects with the widow who was the real-life inspiration for his novel, The Miseducation of Henry Cane. Maggie teaches a class on her past art and is confronted with a big problem.

videos.title: The Baroness
videos.overview: When Caitlin needs help with a Vassar event, Liza is forced to turn to an inconvenient source: Quinn. Kelsey is unhappy with her time in the spotlight and tries to find a way out of it. Maggie gets cancelled.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: Liza and Charles work closely together to land a married writing duo; after Redmond calls her out, Kelsey takes drastic measures to keep an author she nurtured at her literary salon; Kelsey's personal life gets complicated.

videos.title: Inku-baited
videos.overview: Maggie debuts a new art show at an unconventional venue; Clare helps Kelsey at work, as their dating lives become intertwined; Liza convinces Charles to come to her literary salon where a major talent reads.

videos.title: Make No Mustique
videos.overview: Things seem to be warming up between Liza and Charles, but a piece of intel and an exotic trip make Liza feel iced out; Kelsey moves into a new apartment, and Lauren throws her a housewarming party with a surprising ending.

videos.title: Older
videos.overview: Charles and Liza make amends and promise not to lie anymore, but Kelsey's plans force Liza to withhold the truth. Lauren plans a romantic reunion. Sparks fly between Maggie and an enemy-turned-friend.
